//: Cell [3,0,0] of a ropeway:tensionstation: the mass, hanging in the guide that runs three cells up its machine leg. It has no class and no block entity, and that is the change - it used to carry both, purely to put itself in a position table so a line could ask whether any weight stood within eight blocks of any of its towers. Membership of a station answers that exactly, so there is nothing left for either to do.
//nomechpower: Deliberately NOT a mechanical power node. It is a rope tensioner, not a machine: it stores nothing, is wound by nothing and takes no axle. The drive station's intake is the network's consumer.
